summary.en: Runs any motion brick on threes (each pose held three frames) until a switch, marks the switch with two inverted impact frames, then lets the rest run smooth on ones.
summary.zh: 套在任一部件外：开头一拍三（每个姿势停三帧，像手绘作画），到切换点闪两帧反相冲击帧，之后一拍一逐帧丝滑。

fits: A climax that should feel faster than what came before; hand-drawn, anime or zine styles; one moment per film.
notFor: Calm, continuous films (the steps read as dropped frames); dom bricks (canvas only for now).

intent.en: The climax feels faster than anything before it: a hand-drawn, stepping move suddenly runs smooth, and the switch itself is the high point.
intent.zh: 高潮显得比之前任何时候都快：先是手绘式一顿一顿，突然变成逐帧丝滑，换拍这一下本身就是看点。

content.en: Wraps one canvas motion brick with a large move (each 3-frame step ≥ 30 px) and the moment to switch; no text of its own.
content.zh: 套在一块位移够大的 canvas 部件外（每 3 帧一步至少 30 px），给出切换时刻；自身不带文字。

fits.zh: 要比前面更快的高潮；手绘、动画、zine 风格；一支片一次。

notFor.zh: 安静连续的片子（顿挫读成掉帧）；dom 部件（目前只支持 canvas）。

en: Each step on threes must move ≥ 30 px; small steps read as dropped frames.
Mark the switch (a hit sound or a label); otherwise viewers only feel "it got faster".
One time-manipulator per shot: not with time-freeze or hit-stop.
zh: 一拍三时每步位移要 ≥ 30 px；小步读成渲染掉帧。
切换点要有标记（一声打点或角标）；否则观众只觉得“变快了”。
一个镜头只能有一个时间操纵者：别和 time-freeze、顿帧叠用。

upstream.name: 作画式节奏变拍
upstream.summary: 一拍三转一拍一——元素先以每 3 帧一步的手翻书顿挫移动，高潮瞬间切成逐帧丝滑冲刺，帧率量化的突变本身就是看点
upstream.use: 单元素的强调性位移（卡片入场、指标冲线）；需要"手工感→高潮爆发"反差的段落
